newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sells KomiTEK 3 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Russia sells KomiTEK 3 pct stake.

text.p: A three percent stake in Russian oil holding company KomiTEK, whose major operating unit is Komineft, was sold for 24.81 billion roubles ($4.4 million), a Komi Property Fund official said on Wednesday.
The winner of the auction with took place on Tuesday was not disclosed. A total of 4,984,664 shares were sold for 4,980 roubles each, the official said.
The starting price for 11 lots of shares offered at the cash auction was 1,000 roubles, and bids ranged from 1,050 to 5,250 roubles, the official said.
At the previous cash auction on February 16, 1996 three percent of KomiTEK shares were sold at an average price of 1,199.6 roubles.
Russia will offer 29.3 percent of KomiTEK shares at an investment tender on April 18. Foreign companies are not allowed to participate.

The minimum bid price for the 48,680,800 shares is 17 billion roubles plus $10.8 million in investment and responsibility for KomiTEK's overdue tax payments, the extent of which has not been released.
